title: C# Loops Advanced: Foreach & While
description: Loops allow you to execute a block of code repeatedly. While 'for' loops are great for known counts, 'foreach' is optimized for iterating through collections like arrays. The 'while' and 'do-while' loops are used when the number of iterations depends on a condition being true.

challenges.title: Foreach Sum
challenges.exercise: Given 'int[] nums = {1, 2, 3}'. Use a foreach loop to print each number.
